scope: Local isolated transports and authorization, generated media, real SQLite/LiveKit/Chromium where explicitly stated. Not installed EXEs, native capture, WAN, or target60FPS capacity.

cases.name: race-control
cases.scope: Disposable HTTP/WS/SQLite; simulated LiveKit control-plane only; no media/performance or external deployment validation
checks: SFU disabled by default in discovery and signaling
Disabled capability preserves legacy roster shape
Disabled flag issues no LiveKit control RPC
Explicit optional SFU capability advertised
Only negotiated clients have authoritative SFU capability
Token requires exact active capable peer, channel, user and session with strict body
Signed screen-only token uses authoritative metadata and existing room namespace
Gateway validates renewed token, bound peer, sources and signature
Bounded ACK relays with server identity only between negotiated clients
Reconciliation repairs sources, metadata and data permissions for linked peers
Mute waits for the preceding grant on the same SFU identity
An unrelated SFU identity remains admissible while the grant is blocked
A completed mute cannot be overwritten by the stale reconciliation grant
Mute preserves native screen-source restrictions
Muted participant may receive but cannot publish
PUBLISH revoked during CreateRoom is rechecked before signing
Unmute cannot override current denied PUBLISH in SFU token
CONNECT revoked during CreateRoom blocks token and existing SFU reentry
Leaving during CreateRoom cannot issue a token and renewed token cannot rejoin
Reentry allocates a new peer and rejects the obsolete peer token request
Logout rejects reentry and the existing reconciliation removes the linked SFU participant

cases.name: real-signaling
cases.scope: Real local signaling/control plane through Harmony RTC gateway
checks: Client-supplied proxy headers do not provide RTC credentials
Conflicting header/query credentials fail closed
Gateway does not expose LiveKit administration
Both validate route versions reach real LiveKit
Real LiveKit rejects a client attempt to override signed peer metadata
JoinResponse preserves signed user/session identity and peer metadata
Real LiveKit admits only screen sources and prohibits metadata/data publication
Actual LiveKit renewal retains identity/metadata and extends expiration
Gateway accepts the actual renewed LiveKit token
Completed mute revokes publish permission in real LiveKit
Mute denies original and actual renewed publisher tokens
Muted participant reconnects as receiver only
Unmute restores only currently authorized publication
Leaving rejects renewed tokens and closes existing SFU signaling
A new call peer cannot reuse the previous peer renewal
Session revocation rejects entry and removes real SFU signaling
An unavailable media backend yields a bounded gateway failure

cases.name: eight-browser-routing
cases.scope: Eight isolated real Chromium engines, real Harmony/SQLite/LiveKit, generated sources; transport and lifecycle only
checks: Eight real Chromium engines retain their original P2P voice tracks
All fifty-six incoming P2P microphone paths receive and decode generated audio
Eight screen-only SDK rooms connect using production HTTP and RTC gateway
After confirmed SFU ACK only screen senders retire; original voice remains P2P
One capped recipient falls back independently without moving the other six
SFU loss preserves all eight original P2P microphones and connected calls
No unhandled browser errors during hybrid switching
